info.title: transit
info.description: Normalized JSON over the NYC transit feeds: the MTA subway, LIRR, Metro-North and buses, PATH, NYC Ferry and Citi Bike. Times are epoch seconds. Every route but `/health` needs the token.

get.summary: Next trains at a subway station
get.description: Next trains per route and direction. If some upstream feeds failed, the answer is still 200 with what was available, `unavailableFeeds`, and a shorter cache.

parameters.name: stop
parameters.description: A station id from /stops/search (stop ids joined with `+`, such as `127+725+902+A27+R16`), a GTFS stop id (`127`) or one platform (`127N`). Case insensitive.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Trains per route and direction. Default 3, at most 10 (larger values are lowered to 10).

get.summary: Find subway stations by name
get.description: Station complexes matching a name, best first. Changes only with a deploy.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Station name, or part of one (`times sq`, `bedford`).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Stations to return. Default 10, at most 25 (larger values are lowered to 25).

400.description: Missing or too long `q`, or bad `limit`.

get.summary: Subway service alerts
get.description: The alerts in effect now, optionally for one route or station.

parameters.name: route
parameters.description: Only alerts about this route id (`A`, `6X`). Case insensitive.

parameters.name: stop
parameters.description: Only alerts naming one of this station's stops, or a whole route that stops there. A station id from /stops/search (stop ids joined with `+`, such as `127+725+902+A27+R16`), a GTFS stop id (`127`) or one platform (`127N`). Case insensitive.

get.summary: Where a subway route's trains are
get.description: The stop each train of the route is at or heading to. The subway feeds carry no coordinates.

parameters.name: route
parameters.description: A route id (`A`, `6X`). Case insensitive.

get.summary: Subway arrivals as one line of text
get.description: One line of `text/plain` for a launcher hint: the station, then the next trains. Errors are JSON. `max-age` in `Cache-Control` says how long a client may keep the line. The next train per route and direction.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A station name: the best /stops/search match is used.

parameters.name: stop
parameters.description: Instead of `q`. A station id from /stops/search (stop ids joined with `+`, such as `127+725+902+A27+R16`), a GTFS stop id (`127`) or one platform (`127N`). Case insensitive.

get.summary: Next trains at a PATH station
get.description: Next trains per route and direction.

parameters.name: station
parameters.description: A station id from /path/stations (`WTC`, `HOB`, `09S`). Case insensitive.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Trains per route and direction. Default 3, at most 10 (larger values are lowered to 10).

get.summary: PATH stations
get.description: The 13 stations with the routes serving them.

get.summary: PATH arrivals as one line of text
get.description: One line of `text/plain` for a launcher hint: the station, then the next trains. Errors are JSON. `max-age` in `Cache-Control` says how long a client may keep the line. The next train to each destination.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A station name (`hoboken`, `wtc`, `journal sq`): the best match is used.

parameters.name: station
parameters.description: Instead of `q`. A station id from /path/stations (`WTC`, `HOB`, `09S`). Case insensitive.

get.summary: Next departures at a LIRR station

parameters.name: station

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Departures to return. Default 10, at most 30 (larger values are lowered to 30).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: stations to return with `q`. Default 10, at most 25 (larger values are lowered to 25).

parameters.name: station
parameters.description: Only alerts naming this station, or a whole route that stops there. A station id from /<agency>/stations. Case insensitive.

get.summary: Next buses at a bus stop
get.description: The buses on their way to one stop, from MTA Bus Time, every route in one list, cancelled trips marked. Stops are found by the code on their sign, or with `/bus/nearby`.

parameters.name: stop
parameters.description: The six-digit stop code on the bus stop sign (`308209`), as Bus Time knows it. Stable: store it as a favorite.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Buses to return. Default 10, at most 30 (larger values are lowered to 30).

404.description: Bus Time knows no such stop.

get.summary: Bus arrivals as one line of text
get.description: One line of `text/plain` for a launcher hint: the station, then the next trains. Errors are JSON. `max-age` in `Cache-Control` says how long a client may keep the line. The next bus of each route.

parameters.name: stop
parameters.description: The six-digit stop code on the bus stop sign (`308209`), as Bus Time knows it. Stable: store it as a favorite.

404.description: Bus Time knows no such stop.

get.summary: Where a bus route's buses are
get.description: Every bus on one route, both directions, from MTA Bus Time: position, heading and next stop.

parameters.name: route
parameters.description: A bus route id (`M15`, `Q06`, `BX12`). Select Bus Service routes end in `+` (`M15+`, sent as `M15%2B`) or can be written `M15-SBS`. Case insensitive.

404.description: Unknown route, or one Bus Time does not run.

get.summary: Bus stops near a point
get.description: The bus stops within 500 m of a point, nearest first, with the code `/bus/arrivals` takes and the routes that stop there. From MTA Bus Time.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of the point, in decimal degrees.

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Longitude of the point, in decimal degrees.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Stops to return. Default 10, at most 25 (larger values are lowered to 25).

400.description: Missing or out of range `lat` or `lon`, or bad `limit`.

get.summary: Bus service alerts
get.description: The alerts in effect now, optionally for one route. No stop is named.

parameters.name: route
parameters.description: Only alerts about this route. A bus route id (`M15`, `Q06`, `BX12`). Select Bus Service routes end in `+` (`M15+`, sent as `M15%2B`) or can be written `M15-SBS`. Case insensitive.

get.summary: Bikes and docks at a Citi Bike station
get.description: Classic bikes, e-bikes and free docks at one station.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A station id from /citibike/nearby. Exact: ids are opaque strings.

get.summary: Citi Bike stations near a point
get.description: The closest stations on the street, nearest first, with their bikes and docks.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of the point, in decimal degrees.

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Longitude of the point, in decimal degrees.

parameters.name: n
parameters.description: Stations to return. Default 5, at most 25 (larger values are lowered to 25).

400.description: Missing or bad `lat` or `lon`, or bad `n`.

get.summary: Service health
get.description: Which static subway schedule is deployed. No token, never cached.

stops.description: GTFS stop ids the station is made of.

updatedAt.description: Oldest header timestamp among the feeds used; null when no feed serves the stop.

groups.description: In MTA route order, then `N` before `S`.

unavailableFeeds.description: Present when some upstream feeds failed; their groups are missing.

route.description: GTFS route id. Diamond express trips keep their own (`6X`, `7X`, `FX`).

name.description: Rider-facing route name (`S` for the shuttles).

direction.description: The MTA's northbound or southbound platform.

time.description: When the train reaches the stop (epoch seconds).

headsign.description: Name of the trip's last passenger stop in the feed.

assigned.description: A train has been assigned to the trip: it is running or about to leave its terminal. The feed also lists trips due to start in the next 30 minutes before a train is assigned; those are likelier to be changed or cancelled.

change.description: How the trip differs from its schedule, when the MTA marks it: rerouted, skipping stops, or turned short of its usual terminal. Null for a scheduled trip, and when the feed doesn't say (the B Division routes mark changes differently).

stalled.description: The train hasn't moved for over 90 seconds. Its predictions stop with it, so `time` is too early; station countdown clocks stop counting down then.

delayed.description: The feed reports the train delayed ("Train delayed").

id.description: Station id, for `stop` in the other routes. Stable: store it as a favorite.

stops.description: The GTFS stops (parent stations) it is made of.

routes.description: Routes scheduled here, in MTA order. Diamond express variants are left out.

alerts.description: In effect now: current events first, then planned work; by priority, then newest first.

stop.description: The station `stop` resolved to, when given.

stops.description: GTFS stop ids the station is made of.

vehicles.description: Northbound first, each direction in stop id order. The feeds carry no coordinates.

direction.description: From the platform the train is at or heading to; null when unknown.

headsign.description: Name of the trip's last passenger stop in the feed, empty when unknown.

stop.description: The stop the train is at or heading to; null when unknown.

updatedAt.description: Oldest update time among the station's trains in the feed; null when it lists none.

groups.description: In PATH's route order, then toward New York before New Jersey.

route.description: PATH route id (`HOB-WTC`, `JSQ-33-HOB`). A line color PATH hasn't used before shows under its color.

direction.description: `NY` toward Manhattan or `NJ`, as the feed labels the train at this station.

time.description: When the train reaches the station. A train at the platform stays listed for 2 minutes after it.

id.description: The feed's station code. Stable: store it as a favorite.

routes.description: Routes with scheduled service, in PATH's order.

arrivals.description: Every route and direction in one list, soonest first, like a departure board.
Every route and direction in one list, soonest first, like a departure board.

time.description: When it leaves this stop, or arrives where its trip ends.

delay.description: Seconds behind schedule (negative: ahead), when the feed says.

track.description: LIRR and Metro-North: the track it uses at this station (`2`, `2A`, `204`), when the railroad has posted it.

status.description: Metro-North: the train's status at this station, as the railroad words it (`On-Time`, `Late`, `Arriving`, `Departed`, `Bus` for a bus substitute).

query.description: The search text, trimmed, when there was one.

id.description: GTFS stop id. Stable: store it as a favorite.

query.description: The search text, trimmed, when there was one.

id.description: GTFS stop id. Stable: store it as a favorite.

alerts.description: In effect now: current events first, then planned work; by priority, then newest first.
In effect now: current events first, then planned work; by priority, then newest first.

updatedAt.description: Oldest header timestamp among the feeds used.

vehicles.description: By route name. Positions older than 15 minutes are left out.

label.description: The number riders and crews know it by (train number, boat name); empty when the feed has none.

headsign.description: Where its trip ends, empty when unknown.

status.description: Relative to `stop`; null when the feed doesn't say.

name.description: From Bus Time; null when no bus is on its way to tell it.

arrivals.description: Every route in one list: soonest first, then buses without a prediction, nearest first.

time.description: Predicted arrival. Null when Bus Time has no prediction, usually for a bus still at its terminal.

headsign.description: Where the trip ends, as the bus shows it.

distance.description: Bus Time's distance for riders: `approaching`, `2 stops away`, `1.3 miles away`. Empty when unknown.

atTerminal.description: The bus is waiting to start its trip or still finishing its previous one, so its time is less sure.

cancelled.description: The trip is cancelled: listed at its scheduled time (or without one) so riders know it won't come.

vehicle.description: The bus number; empty when unknown.

vehicles.description: Every bus on the route, both directions, by headsign then bus number.

headsign.description: Where its trip ends, as the bus shows it.

heading.description: Compass heading in degrees, clockwise from north; null when unknown.

stop.description: Its next stop: the stop code and name. Null when unknown.

distance.description: How far from that stop, for riders: `at stop`, `approaching`, `1 stop away`.

atTerminal.description: Waiting to start its trip or still finishing its previous one.

stops.description: Stops within 500 m of the point, nearest first; empty when there are none.

id.description: The six-digit code on the stop sign, which `/bus/arrivals` takes.

name.description: As Bus Time names it (`1 AV/E 14 ST`).

direction.description: The compass direction buses there travel (`N`, `NE`, ... `NW`); empty when unknown.

distance.description: Meters from the point, in a straight line.

alerts.description: In effect now: current events first, then planned work; by priority, then newest first.

id.description: The MTA's alert id, without the status rank it appends to its entity ids, so it stays the same when the status changes.

planned.description: Scheduled work rather than something that just happened.

category.description: The MTA's status for the alert, such as `Delays`, `Part Suspended` or `Planned - Stops Skipped`: one of the 35 names in the MTA's status table. Null when the feed has none (NYC Ferry).

priority.description: The status's rank in the MTA's table, from 1 (`No Scheduled Service`) to 35 (`Suspended`); higher is more serious. Null with `category`.

header.description: One or two plain-text sentences. Subway texts name routes in brackets: `[A][C] trains`.

description.description: Longer plain text, empty when there is none.

direction.description: Subway only: the one direction the alert affects there, the MTA's northbound (`N`) or southbound (`S`) platform. Null when it affects both or the feed doesn't say.

stops.description: Stops the alert names, when the static data knows them.

start.description: Start of the period in effect now; null when open.

end.description: End of the period in effect now; null when open.

stations.description: Nearest first. Only stations on the street.

id.description: Opaque (a UUID or a long digit string). Stable: store it as a favorite.

capacity.description: Docks at the station, in any state.

renting.description: False when the station isn't renting bikes.

returning.description: False when the station isn't accepting returns.

reportedAt.description: When the station last reported. Absent if it never did.
